description: This file defines a PHP class 'Customer' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' namespace, which extends the base Controller class and handles email notifications related to customer actions such as approval and denial. It includes methods for sending email notifications to customers upon approval or denial, rendering email templates, and configuring email settings.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class managing customer-related email notifications, including approval and denial emails.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Handles sending an approval email to a customer based on their customer ID, preparing email content with store and language data, and dispatching the email.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Handles sending a denial email to a customer based on their customer ID, preparing email content with store and language data, and dispatching the email.
